text:
rachel_net: Morning — apac-sg1 nodes showing recurring p99 encode spikes. GPUs idle, NIC tx queue 2 on the hosts is pegged and we're seeing tx drops. Pattern: tiny token-by-token RPCs from a small set of tenants.
edward_sched: thanks. top talkers?
rachel_net: flow-agg: tenant-playback (52%), tenant-sanity (20%), infra-sync (9%), misc smalls. Packets tiny, lots of short TCP sessions causing IRQ bounce.
harper_sre: any recent host driver or coalescing changes in apac?
rachel_net: nothing in infra deploys. onset ~01:10 local time. tcptracer shows many connections with sustained tx ring occupancy.
matt_ops: quick mitigation idea: a cross-AZ preemptible "quiet-pool-apac" replicated in sg1/sg2, apply per-host eBPF tbf shaping for the shaped slice and soft-redirect noisy tenants. Avoid reserved carveouts to keep cost down.
edward_sched: agree. plan: soft-weight 15% -> observe 12m -> 40% -> 80% with monitoring gates. Also lower backfill weight for that slice so we don't trigger allocator thrash.
luke_prod: FYI product concerns: moving customers to a lower SLA slice impacts SLOs. We'll prepare comms if we need to escalate to full cutover.
costbot: projection: converting slice to reserved for 24h ~ +$2.0k. Keeping preemptible keeps uplift minimal.
harper_sre: add eBPF per-host probe to capture per-pod tx bursts and IRQ rates. opsbot, open incident with paging when p99>220ms for 10m.
opsbot: Incident created: INC-2026-9201 "apac-sg1 egress irq saturation" paging thresholds set.
rachel_net: quick safe commands to tag and soft-route:
```bash
# tag tenants
kubectl annotate tenant tenant-playback routing=quiet-pool-apac
kubectl annotate tenant tenant-sanity routing=quiet-pool-apac
# soft weight (15%)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://scheduler.internal/api/v1/routes/weights \
  -d '{"slice":"quiet-pool-apac","weight":0.15,"region":"apac"}'
```
edward_sched: perform 15% now, gather 12m window. If p99 improves >30% promote to 40%. If preemptions spike or tail worsens, rollback and try AZ-sharded placement.
matt_ops: also suggest a proxy-level token-bucket (burst smoothing) as a follow-up so noisy pps doesn't hammer NIC rings next time.
harper_sre: long term items: scheduler soft-quotas, proxy pacing, NIC driver tuning for coalescing defaults. I'll capture RCA and file RFCs.
rachel_net: 15% in flight at 02:06UTC. Alert suppression active for 10m while mitigation proceeds.
opsbot: Alert suppressed for 10m.
rachel_net: 02:18UTC update: p99 improved from 480ms -> 300ms with 15% routing. host tx ring depth down ~33%.
edward_sched: good signal. proceed to 40% and keep cost tag on incident for allocation.
costbot: cost tracker attached to INC-2026-9201; tagging delta to the impacted test budget.
luke_prod: will draft brief comms for affected tenants if we need to make SLA concessions.
harper_sre: documenting runbook "quiet-pool-apac soft-redirect" and follow-ups. thanks team :thumbsup:
